title: The Hound of the Baskervilles
author: Arthur Conan Doyle
summary: A family curse speaks of a huge spectral hound on the Devon moors, and the latest heir fears he will be its next victim. Holmes sends Watson to the lonely moorland house to keep watch.
readIf: you want an atmospheric, creepy Holmes case with a strong setting.
skipIf: you want Holmes at the centre of every scene, since he is absent for much of the middle.

pairings.reason: The first Holmes novel, which is a good place to see how the detective and his friend began.
Another story in which an old English house and its past hold the real menace.
A modern, grounded detective duo in the Holmes tradition, with a gentler sense of dread.
